correction: Add the most recent completed order's measured-minus-predicted world displacement and world rotation-vector change to the new 250 ms forecast. No tuned weight, clamp, or future controller outcome.
held_out: Later states after twenty private policy steps and distinct target seeds; none of the eight preceding calibration targets is reused.
comparison: Controller, uncorrected body-head search and past-order-corrected body-head search from the same snapshots, goal and random state.
unchanged: 30 search updates, learning rate 0.1, baseline retained, +/-1.80 cm per raw coordinate and 11 degrees per part before normal smoothing; strength and gaze fixed.
acceptance: Actual goal error improves over both the controller and uncorrected body-head choice, with 95% paired uncertainty computed across the eight body means.
scope: Auditor-supplied reachable physical goals; goal-memory integration is still required before autonomous use.
